integrity_notes: The article contains an analytical argument; accompanying Python standard-library checks are numerical corroboration, not infinite proofs or independent certification. Archival first-source date is the dated 2005 public manuscript record, not journal issue date.
scientific_limitations: The exact time-integrated Neumann heat BV-to-spacetime-L2 squared norm is a one-variable Fourier maximization for every horizon. The short-horizon optimal knots are classified only for sufficiently small horizons; the exact intermediate switching diagram and sharp transition time are not determined. The unique midpoint is proved for all horizons at least 1/2. Real unit-interval data and ordinary interior BV variation only.
title: A sharp cumulative heat-error law and horizon-dependent jump migration
